mcq_fix.s: In Vihaan Kumar v. State of Haryana (2025), the Supreme Court emphasised which of the following?
mcq_fix.why: judgment is of 2025; stem's '14 August 2026' was a note date, not the ruling date

pyq_bad.why: garbled: two questions merged in stem

patterns: Article-number recall dominates: double jeopardy/self-incrimination = Art. 20, arrested persons = Art. 22, marry by choice = Art. 21; APPSC-G2 asked the self-incrimination term and Art. 20 for double jeopardy.
86th Amendment 2002 is a stock item (Art. 21A, 11th Fundamental Duty, in force 2010); APPSC trap was 2001 vs 2002 and 86th vs 96th.
APPSC-G2 2025 used a two-statement item (no FR to marry; travel abroad is an FR) - both right.
Preventive detention asked only as the 3-month limit; app goes much deeper (BNSS sections, legislative competence, NCRB data, recent cases).
